chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 316: Calm & Reinforcements — Han Li Gets Backup From His Sect
chapter_meta_description: After a half-month ceasefire, Han Li senses Foundation Establishment cultivators outside—but it's his long-awaited sect reinforcements. The Black Fiend Sect Master also reveals his true strategy.
og_description: A quiet chapter of strategic calculations and long-awaited backup as Han Li reunites with his sect seniors.
twitter_description: Han Li gets his first real backup from the sect, while the Black Fiend Sect Master reveals his coldly pragmatic calculus.

lore_anchors.definition: A ritual practice in cultivation fiction where a cultivator consumes the life essence of living beings—often cultivators themselves—to accelerate their own breakthrough. It is one of the most efficient but monstrous paths to power.
A forbidden skill that allows a cultivator to temporarily assume a demonic form, gaining massive combat power at the cost of vitality and self-control. It is typically a last-resort technique.

A single-use magical treasure compressed into a talisman format, allowing a lower-level cultivator to access a fraction of a higher-level artifact’s power. Its power varies dramatically based on the original artifact and the skill of its creator.
A sect specializing in puppet arts and mechanical constructs. Their techniques allow a cultivator to control multiple puppets simultaneously, creating a versatile and dangerous combat style.
